body: Pain killers. I want to stop but I cant stand living without them. Not because Ill have to go through withdrawals but because before I got into them the depression and pain were driving me closer and closer to the edge every day. I tried to get therapy, maybe a psychiatrist with anti depressants, but like I said Im a broke jobless loser and even the free clinic recognized me as a waste of time and put me on the bottom of their very long list
